title: What features make one market intelligence website better than another?
author: NaiveSuspect251
selftext:
I've been comparing a few market intelligence websites recently, and they all seem to promise better insights, faster analysis, or smarter decision-making. But once you look past the marketing, it's not always clear what actually makes one platform stand out.

For those who use these tools regularly, what features or capabilities have genuinely improved your research or investing process? What do you think separates a great market intelligence website from one that's just average?

comments.author: Rare_Inflation3178
comments.body: Data quality and transparency matter more than the number of features. The best platforms help you turn an idea into something testable, show the historical context, and make it clear where the signal might fail. Most average ones just repackage the same news and charts with an AI summary.
